runtime: Windows host CPython 3.11.9; deterministic standard-library simulation; no WSL/container/model/GPU/GUI/network
analysis_unit: one isolated offered-stop cohort assigned exactly one predeclared policy; no mixed arms on shared capacity
advice_budget: exactly one advice per offered ID in each advice arm; zero in no_advice; per-row and summary audited
identification_boundary: single deterministic cohort per frozen case; synthetic counterexample only; no population or causal policy-effect estimate
cohort_refinement: Issue comment 5943195315: freeze cohort/resource graph/window, adoption schedule, offered IDs, reset/cooldown and carryover; if not established report HOLD_INTERFERENCE. T0 uses isolated synthetic cohorts.
literature_refinement: Issue comment 5943274533: compare public warning+bounded stagger with source-bound recipient-specific authorized routing; include wording-only placebo and slow/forbidden alternative cases.
construction_only_note: v1 construction outputs are preserved as superseded construction-only evidence; never reuse as v2 or formal results.

controls.low_adoption: 2/4 adopted resolve, retain four offered IDs
controls.disjoint_null: all four resolve under the routing policy
controls.forbidden_alternative: only individually authorized recipients may use it
controls.slow_alternative: do not select a route missing the deadline
